en.summary: B12/folate deficiency can cause tiredness, breathlessness, pale skin, pins and needles, glossitis. NHS: blood tests via GP; treatment is clinician-guided (diet, tablets, or injections). Never invent B12 injection schedules here.
seeDoctorIf: Known risk (diet, absorption disorders, metformin long-term — discuss testing)
doNot: Do not invent B12 injection regimens

fr.summary: Carence B12/folates : fatigue, dyspnée, paresthésies. Bilans chez le médecin. Pas de schémas d'injections inventés.

he.summary: חסר B12/פולאט: עייפות, קוצר נשימה, נימול. בדיקות אצל רופא. אין לוח זריקות מומצא.

ru.summary: Дефицит B12/фолатов: усталость, одышка, парестезии. Анализы у врача. Схемы инъекций не выдумывать.

sources.name: NHS — Vitamin B12 or folate deficiency anaemia
